visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the Division Loop with One Expression
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A flag and a loop that halves the number again and again test for a power of two. Replace them with the bit trick n > 0 && (n & (n - 1)) == 0. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A number with a single 1 bit loses it when you AND with n - 1. One comparison now does what the loop did in log2(n) steps.
